height_interpretation: Source prints age/sexheight<3rd percentile (below−2SD). No conversion or exact equivalence is asserted. Both separately recorded classifications agreeing is sufficient for this limited condition check; both failing proves failure under either reading. Discordance or a missing reference remains source review. Both measures are NOT claimed to be a statutory testing requirement.
pathways: Persistent growth failure OR (documented completed post-transplant year AND absence of steroid therapy AND absence of spontaneous growth) OR nephropathic cystinosis-related CKD; common annual growth velocity percentile<25 and height condition. No single branch is mandatory if another is explicitly confirmed.
scope: Necessary initiation conditions only. Three alternative branch flags do not establish parent CKD stage/dialysis duration/nutrition/metabolic conditions. Scope, date, known exclusions and dose remain separate. Never derive persistence, a transplant anniversary or clinical state; never apply initiation conditions to continuation.
